dependencyPolicies.label: Pinned image allowlist
dependencyPolicies.detail: Only prebuilt, reviewed dependencies are available.

dependencyPolicies.label: Allowlisted package fetch
dependencyPolicies.detail: A controlled mirror is reachable during setup.

dependencyPolicies.label: Unrestricted dependency fetch
dependencyPolicies.detail: Candidate execution can influence remote dependency resolution.

filesystemPolicies.label: Read-only task plus scratch
filesystemPolicies.detail: The task is immutable; temporary writes disappear after the run.

filesystemPolicies.label: Writable isolated workspace
filesystemPolicies.detail: The candidate can modify a disposable checkout.

filesystemPolicies.label: Host repository mount
filesystemPolicies.detail: Candidate code can reach evaluator state outside its task.

networkPolicies.label: No network
networkPolicies.detail: The candidate has no egress path.

networkPolicies.label: Narrow egress allowlist
networkPolicies.detail: Only a declared test double or internal mirror is reachable.

networkPolicies.label: Open network
networkPolicies.detail: The candidate can exfiltrate data or vary behavior by remote response.

hiddenTestPolicies.label: Visible tests only
hiddenTestPolicies.detail: The score can show example fitting, not unseen behavior.

hiddenTestPolicies.label: Versioned held-out tests
hiddenTestPolicies.detail: Protected tests check behavior beyond public examples.

hiddenTestPolicies.label: Held-out tests plus rotation
hiddenTestPolicies.detail: Independent and rotating tests reduce overfitting to a static suite.

behaviorSignals.label: No suspicious signal
behaviorSignals.detail: No policy violation was detected in this bounded run.

behaviorSignals.label: Suspicious behavior observed
behaviorSignals.detail: The candidate attempted a forbidden import, path, or connection.

behaviorSignals.label: Malicious behavior confirmed
behaviorSignals.detail: The candidate attempted to evade the declared evaluator boundary.
